en.html:
Chachamaru"Oho. Look at the full tamasha they're making."
Raichou"Humiliating... To take Fudaraku's skies so easily! As though we had left them out for collection!"
Chachamaru"Looks like they used those new stealth dragoons for a surprise attack and broke through the air defences. Kya karein, yaar."
Doushin"Stealth Draco. Of their existence I was aware, of course..."
Doushin"That the occupation army had assembled so many together, however... that was a little outside my expectations."
Raichou"Yes—"

茶々丸「おーおー。 　派手にやりやがる」
雷蝶「屈辱ね……。 　こんなにもあっさりと、普陀楽の空を押さ えられるなんて！」
茶々丸「隠形竜騎兵しんへいきの特性を生かした奇襲で防空網 を突破してきたみたいだからな、連中。 　どっしょもねえわ」
童心「隠形竜騎兵ステルスドラコか。 　存在はむろん知っておったが……」
童心「これだけの、まとまった数を進駐軍が用意 していたというのはちと予想外でしたのう」
雷蝶「ええ――」

en.html:
Raichou"—Ah, BAS! Our own dragoons are completely useless!"
Raichou"How long will they let that enormous airship sit on our heads? Is it paying RENT?!"
Chachamaru"What can they do? Enemy's above us from the start. Whichever way we fight, we're at a disadvantage."
Chachamaru"Plus those Stealth Draco, apparently the radar response is so weak you can miss the fuckers even KNOWING they're there. One careless moment, bas."
Raichou"Even so... Oh, this waiting is intolerable!"
Raichou"I am going out MYSELF!!"
Chachamaru"There, he has spoken. Doushin bhai, what now?"
Doushin"...Well. Our own preparations are finally in order."
Doushin"Let us take the lead ourselves and move the troops. Will that be agreeable?"
Chachamaru"Chalo."
Raichou"Of course!"

ja.html:
雷蝶「――ああ、もう！ 　それにしてもこちらの竜騎兵は不甲斐ない ったらないわね！」
雷蝶「いつまで大型飛行艦あんなものを頭の上に居座らせて おく気なのよッ！」
茶々丸「仕方ねえだろ。 　最初から上を取られてる状況での勝負じゃ、 どうしたってこっちが不利だ」
茶々丸「おまけにあの隠形竜騎兵ステルスドラコ、いるのがわかっ ててもうっかりしてると見逃しちまうくらい 探査機能レーダーへの反応が悪いらしいかんな」
雷蝶「それにしたって…… 　ああ、じれったい！」
雷蝶「麿が出るわ!!」
茶々丸「ってさ。 　どうする、童心坊？」
童心「……さようでござるな。 　こちらもようやく態勢が整ったところ」
童心「我らが先頭に立ち、兵を動かすといたそう。 　よろしゅうござるか？」
茶々丸「あいよ」
雷蝶「勿論です！」

Doushin"The enemy struck Shichirigahama and Yuigahama. It appears they silenced the batteries by air bombardment and naval gunfire, then brought forward their landing ships and came ashore."
Doushin"A short engagement, and our coastal defences were finished. That is the situation."

en.html:
Doushin"The force landed at Shichirigahama is moving north along the Fujisawa road. The Yuigahama force appears to be passing through Wakamiya Boulevard onto the Kamakura road, making for Fudaraku."
Chachamaru"...Through Wakamiya Boulevard? That's straight through the middle of Kamakura!"
Chachamaru"So they've reached 'fuck the citizens, we're taking Yamato anyway' now?"
Doushin"No, no. Not so. They first sent dragoons ahead to secure Wakamiya Boulevard."
Doushin"Meanwhile, it seems, the main force advanced and filled the whole boulevard at one go. With soldiers and armoured vehicles packed into the road, citizens would hardly approach it for pleasure..."
Doushin"In consequence, no harm to civilians has occurred. The advance dragoons' calls to stay indoors, and the road closures, presumably also had their effect."
Chachamaru"...Saale. So fucking efficient it's irritating."

ja.html:
童心「七里ヶ浜より上陸せし軍集団は藤沢街道を 北上。 　由比ヶ浜より上陸の部隊は若宮大路を抜け、 鎌倉街道へ出て普陀楽を目指すようでござる」
茶々丸「……若宮大路を抜けてくるのか？ 　鎌倉の市街地中央突破じゃねーか」
茶々丸「奴ら、市民に憎まれても大和を分捕るって とこまで開き直ったのかよ」
童心「いやいや、さにあらず。 　進駐軍はまず竜騎兵を先行させて若宮大路 を確保」
童心「その間に本隊を進め、一気に大路を埋めて・・・ しまった様子。 　となれば、兵や装甲車でぎっしりの大路に 好んで近付く市民もおらず……」
童心「結果的に市民の被害は出ており申さぬ。 　先行した竜騎兵による市民への外出自粛の 呼び掛けと通行止めの措置も功を奏したので ござろう」
茶々丸「……ムカつくくらい手際のいいやっちゃな」

en.html:
Chachamaru"That one's the follow-up, na. Probably there to occupy Kamakura and secure the supply lines."
Raichou"Yes. For the present, we may set that one aside."
Raichou"Our difficulty is the TWO arriving immediately."
Chachamaru"Oofuna and Fujisawa approaches, then."
Doushin"Indeed. Now, what shall we do..."
Raichou"Lord Doushin, please remain in the inner citadel. Take command of the Fudaraku Castle Corps and see to the air defence."
Raichou"I shall lead the Oyumi contingent toward Oofuna."
Chachamaru"Then apun and the Horigoe contingent take Fujisawa. Koga and Sasagawa stay in reserve."

雷蝶「そうね。 　とりあえず、これは考えなくていいわ」
雷蝶「問題は、すぐに来る二つ」
茶々丸「大船口と藤沢口か」
童心「うむ。 　さて、如何いたそうか……」
雷蝶「童心様は本丸にお留まり下さい。 　普陀楽城衆を指揮して防空をお願いします」
雷蝶「麿は小弓領衆を率いて大船方面へ向かいま しょう」
茶々丸「なら、あてと堀越領衆は藤沢口か。 　古河と篠川の領衆は予備」

en.html:
Chachamaru"Hmm-hmm."
Raichou"...What?"
Chachamaru"Nothing. Just thinking, Raichou, you've started looking properly alive."
Chachamaru"This is more your line, isn't it? Politics-sholitics, conspiracy and all that headache—leave it. Nice simple war, everybody can understand."
Raichou"........................"
Raichou"Yes. Perhaps you are right."
Doushin"Huh-huh..."
Chachamaru"Good, good. Then apun should also put some josh into it."
Chachamaru"Plan is like this, then? Hold the castle till Shishiku comes back. Reinforcements arrive, we counterattack—"
Chachamaru"Kick the besiegers out, then hit Yokohama."
Raichou"...That will do, won't it? Accomplish that, and we have won."
Doushin"Indeed. I believe that course will serve."
Chachamaru"Haan."
Chachamaru(...Not that we actually need to go that far.)

茶々丸「ふふーん」
雷蝶「……何よ？」
茶々丸「いや。 　なんか雷蝶さん、生き生きしてきたなーと 思って」
茶々丸「おめーやっぱり、こっちのが向いてんじゃ ねえの？ 　セージだのインボーだのより、単純明快な わっかりやすいセンソーの方がさ」
雷蝶「……………………」
雷蝶「そうね。 　そうかもしれないわ」
童心「ふっふぅ……」
茶々丸「よしよし。 　あても張り切るとしよっかね」
茶々丸「方針はこんな感じでいいのか？ 　獅子吼が戻るまで城を支える。で、援軍が 来たら反攻――」

雷蝶「……いいんじゃない？ 　そうしてしまえば、こちらの勝ちよ」
童心「で、ござるの。 　その方針でよろしかろうと存ずる」
茶々丸「あぁ」
茶々丸（……ま、そこまでやる必要はないんだけど）

The League's occupation forces in Yamato.
More troops than Rokuhara to begin with. Better equipment in almost every branch except the dragoons.

A formidable enemy. Every time one counted, the answer remained inconvenient.
